why: Only two of the 12 results reached ChatGPT with any text: Consumer Reports and Popular Mechanics. Both are general best-of guides and say nothing about shutoff at low load. The other 10, mostly manuals and blog posts, reached it as bare links. No major reviewer or authority answers this question, so a page that compares idle-shutoff settings by model and checks them with tests would have little competition.
